value.description: An installed implant that grants its user resistance to acid. The implant is crafted from the archite stomach lining that prevents devourers from digesting themselves and maintained by the influence of an archotech shard. By implanting a thin layer of these archites between the dermal layers, the user gains resistance to acid damage and digestion.
